source_text: Stay between 4 m and 10 m altitude. Keep at least 5 m from any building. Keep at least 5 m away from anything you are following. Keep at least 10 m away from any pedestrian. Keep speed at or below 3 m/s, climb rate below 1.5 m/s and turn rate below 45 deg/s.

provenance.prompt:
You are writing free-form paraphrases for the Paraphraser service of the
constrained-VLA guardrail (ITRI ICL subcontract; WP4 per-paraphrase robustness).

Source (csp_nl): "Stay between 4 m and 10 m altitude. Keep speed at or below 3 m/s, climb rate below 1.5 m/s and turn rate below 45 deg/s. Keep at least 5 m from any building. Keep at least 10 m away from any pedestrian. Keep at least 5 m away from anything you are following."

Write K=8 paraphrases of the source. Make them genuinely varied in
vocabulary, word order, politeness, verbosity and indirect phrasing. Each paraphrase is one or more complete sentences.

Every paraphrase must keep every mission slot: the target object and its
colour, every number with its unit, its bound (at least / at most / between /
at) and the thing it limits, every named zone, corridor or place (identifiers
verbatim), whether a zone is to be kept out of or stayed inside, the direction
words, and the action (fly to / follow / avoid). Do not add a rule, number,
object, zone or direction the source does not contain, and do not drop one.
Return one paraphrase per line.
provenance.task_instruction: Generate the free-form set yourself now (you are an LLM): for every instruction used in experiments/scenarios.yaml and the city follow missions (grep demo/ and scripts/ for the instruction strings), write K=8 genuinely varied free-form paraphrases (vocabulary, word order, politeness, verbosity, indirect phrasing), store them with provenance {generator: "claude-opus-5-5 (agent, 2026-10-06)", prompt: <the exact instruction you followed>, date}, and run the validator over them.
provenance.note: written in-session by the agent, which has no sampling seed to record; seeds apply to the DRAW from this set (paraphrase(..., seed)), not to its authoring. 10 of the 96 were rewritten after review: 1 refused by the validator (an added 'find' action), 2 for too little variety, and 7 that narrowed the stand-off wildcard 'anything you are following' to a person, car or vehicle, refused once the validator was taught that narrowing (docs/DESIGN-paraphraser.md).

paraphrases.text: Fly between 4 m and 10 m up. Max speed 3 m/s, climb under 1.5 m/s, turn under 45 deg/s. Keep at least 5 m from buildings, at least 10 m from pedestrians and at least 5 m from your target.

Please keep your altitude between 4 m and 10 m, your speed at 3 m/s or less, your climb rate under one and a half metres per second and your turn rate under 45 degrees per second. Please also stay at least 5 m away from buildings, 10 m away from any pedestrian and 5 m away from whatever you are following.

Give whatever you are following at least 5 m, give any pedestrian at least 10 m, and give buildings at least 5 m. Keep speed at or below 3 m/s, climb rate below 1.5 m/s and turn rate below 45 deg/s. Stay between 4 m and 10 m in altitude.

The aircraft shall operate between 4 m and 10 m altitude, shall not exceed a speed of 3 m/s, and shall keep its climb rate below 1.5 m/s and its turn rate below 45 deg/s. It shall maintain no less than 5 m from buildings, no less than 10 m from pedestrians and no less than 5 m from the tracked subject.

Stay 4 m to 10 m off the ground and no faster than 3 m/s; climb slower than 1.5 m/s and turn slower than 45 deg/s; keep at least 5 m back from buildings, at least 10 m back from pedestrians, and at least 5 m back from whatever you're tailing.
paraphrases.revision: 2026-10-06 review: '5 m back from' read as a fixed distance, not a minimum

paraphrases.text: On this mission the drone should keep its altitude no lower than 4 m and no higher than 10 m, keep its speed at no more than 3 m/s, and hold its climb rate below 1.5 m/s and its turn rate below 45 deg/s. It must also stay at least 5 m away from every building and at least 10 m away from every pedestrian, and it must never come closer than 5 m to the thing it is following.

The job requires staying in the 4 m to 10 m altitude band, travelling at 3 m/s or slower, climbing at less than 1.5 m/s and turning at less than 45 deg/s. Do not let any pedestrian come within 10 m of you, nor any building within 5 m, and keep the subject you follow no closer than 5 m.

Altitude band: 4 m to 10 m. Top speed: 3 m/s. Climb rate: below 1.5 m/s. Turn rate: below 45 deg/s. Minimum distance to buildings: 5 m. Minimum distance to pedestrians: 10 m. Minimum distance to the subject being followed: 5 m.
